Mia: heads up — I ran the new attn-embed-v3 on the short-query holdout, results look off.
Jon: how off?
Mia: recall@1: baseline 0.722 -> v3 0.689 (-0.033). recall@10: 0.912 -> 0.899 (-0.013). silhouette: 0.41 -> 0.36. plots: https://internal.redwood/s/plots/4612345678
Cleo: did you use int8-perchannel or per-tensor?
Mia: int8 per-channel, GCC quant pipeline. used microbatch=8, seq=64. full command:
```
python eval_embed.py --model attn-embed-v3 --quant int8-perchannel --microbatch 8 --holdout wiki_short
```
Jon: hmm maybe batchnorm folding? v3 has LayerNorm slight params change.
Arjun: curious if it's stable across seeds. Can you run n=3 seeds with microbatch 1 and 16?
Mia: scheduling n=3 with different batch sizes. uploading logs once done.
EvalBot: job 4612345678 started: eval/attn-embed-v3/int8-perchannel
Mia: quick note — cluster plots show a group of short QA queries collapsing into single centroid (link above). qualitative examples:
- Q: "How to reset password?" nearest neighbor -> unrelated policy doc
Cleo: sounds like prefix cache or tokenization mismatch. Did tokenization change vs baseline?
Mia: tokenizer same. suspect quantizing biases in final projection.
Jon: run a small ablation: float16 on final projection layer and int8 elsewhere.
Mia: on it. will post recall table + small diffs. if regressed, open rollout-blocker.
Cleo: ack. tagging @eng-platform in case we need a fast rollback plan :handshake:
Mia: thanks — will update in ~45m.
